up: Retrieve compounds reported in document CHEMBL4602605. For each compound, return the following columns: chembl_id (molecule identifier), pref_name (compound name), max_phase (maximum clinical phase), molecule_type (type of molecule), and canonical_smiles (SMILES string). Join the documents table to filter by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4602605', then join compound_records to link documents to molecules, and finally join molecule_dictionary for names/phases/types and compound_structures for SMILES. Order the results by chembl_id ascending. Do not add any row limits.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4602605' ORDER BY md.chembl_id ASC
